newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway stock exchange falls with other markets.
newsitem.headline: Norway stock exchange falls with other markets.

text.p: Norwegian share prices fell on Monday in reaction to Wall Street's plunge last Friday, but recovered somewhat in the afternoon from initial losses.
The Total index closed 1.56 percent lower at 1,271.46 points in moderate turnover of 839 million crowns.
"I think the next few days will be difficult," one dealer said.
He said most sellers on Monday were small investors. "There is not much the big investors can do because there are no buyers of big volumes at satisfactory prices."
Norwegian airliner Braathens SAFE announced it had forged an alliance with KLM Royal Dutch Airline in a deal analysts said will open up competition in the Scandinavian sector.
But Braathen's share price fell 3.5 crowns from Friday to 84 crowns.
Norsk Hydro, an industrial conglomerate and the largest listed company in Norway, fell 8.50 crowns to 395 crowns and was the most traded share at 101 million crowns.
